- Lye which is so toxic and nasty. _____________________ Contents 1Introduction 2Background Information 2.1The DMT plant - Mimosa hostilis root bark 2.2Info about the 3 types of DMT contained in MHRB 2.3About the 2 teks 2.4A little info on Lime 3Tek 1: The Jimjam party 3.1Materials required: 3.2Preparation: 3.3Acidification with Vinegar: 3.4Basification with Lime: 3.5Pulling with Non-Polar Solvent: 3.6Alternative Next-Steps 3.7Salting with Vinegar: 3.8Condensing Tincture Making: 3.9Measuring the tincture: 3.10Evaporation and Smoking: 3.11Smoking: 3.12Super-short Compressed Tek 1 3.13Ethanol Tincture 4Tek 2: The Fluffy White Funfest 4.1About Naphtha 4.2Materials required: 4.3Preparation: 4.4Acidification with Vinegar: 4.5Basification with Lime: 4.6Pulling with Naphtha: 4.7Precipitation Crystallization: 4.8Smoking: 4.9Super-short Compressed Tek 2 5Common issues Troubleshooting Introduction As a comprehensive guide there s lots of information other than just instructions on how to extract DMT but is nonetheless very useful for understanding the process. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- It is the goal of the tek that the reader will be able to understand the reasoning and general chemical processes behind each step while the tek is being performed. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- If you would like to get right into the What do I do? then you can start by reading the Super-short Compressed Tek. (Then the full tek later) Tek 1 (Uses xylene d-limonene) Tek 2 (Uses naphtha) Background Information The DMT plant - Mimosa hostilis root bark While DMT is contained in many plants and animals the plant most commonly used for extractions and the one to be used for this tek is Mimosa Hostilis (abbreviated as MHRB) Mimosa Hostilis Plant, Whole Mimosa Hostilis Root Bark (MHRB), Shredded MHRB, Powdered MHRB Mimosa Hostilis is a shrub that contains N-N-Dimethyltryptamine (DMT) and 2 other similarly psychoactive alkaloids (and some TINY amounts of NMT) in its root-bark . _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- An extremely important note is that I have tried about 10x to get this tek to work with shredded bark and failed each time. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Methods:Pharmahuasca, Mucosahuasca or Smoking White N-N-DMT White DMT I extracted using Tek 2 White N-N-Dimethyltryptamine (DMT) is pure DMT. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- MHRB usually contains about 1 of its weight in White DMT, though yields from extractions of less than 0.5 and up to 2 are not unheard of. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Red Jungle DMT Thick dark red Jungle DMT extracted from by fully depleting the MHRB using naphtha, then pulling with xylene Jungle DMT is also contained in the bark but cannot be extracted into crystals like White DMT Jungle DMT when smoked or consumed in pharmahuasca produces effects similar in duration and effects to White DMT. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- I think the cause of this is because Jungle DMT is ever so slightly soluble in naphtha. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Jimjam - The Full Spectrum Product Jimjam DMT acetate I extracted using Tek 1 with d-limonene If all the alkaloids are together then the product is a full-spectrum product called Jimjam . _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- This term will be used a lot during Tek 1. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- This mix is usually 1-2 of the weight of the MHRB though yields from extractions of more than 2 are not unheard of. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- About the 2 teks Often instead of saying d-limonene, xylene or naphtha they will be referred to as the solvent In each tek many of the processes are the same but the one big difference is the non-polar solvent used. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Tek 2 uses naphtha (lighter fluid) while Tek 1 uses either xylene (paint thinner) or d-limonene (a citrus-derived cleaner but also used to dissolve HIPS 3D-printing supports) (Vegetable oil can also apparently be used for Tek 1, you can  the Nexus for the many long threads talking about using it as a solvent) Naphtha needs to be heated to dissolve or else it won t dissolve anything but its unique solubility properties allow for White DMT to be crystallized out when it is cooled in a freezer. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Tek 2 thus involves a heating-step and a freezer-step that Tek 1 does not have. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- However, naphtha does not dissolve Jungle DMT very well so the extracted product will be almost entirely white DMT and leave the Jungle DMT in the MHRB. d-limonene and xylene dissolve both white DMT and Jungle DMT at room temperate so Tek 1 doesn t need a heating step. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Because of that it will yield full-spectrum product Jimjam DMT but since it is soluble, even when the solvent is cold, freezer precipitation doesn t work, so one of many different methods can be used to isolate the Jimjam DMT from the solvent. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Useful to know: If d-limonene is used, the tek will be 100 food-safe Note:d-limonene still smells very strong and lingers in your house For a first-timer Tek 2 may be better advised than Tek 1 because it requires fewer steps and is well-suited for very small test batches like 30g-50g MHRB. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- I recommend Tek 1 for larger batches. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- A little info on Lime The star of the show (teks) is lime . _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- This food-safe base is a replacement for lye which is very caustic and toxic. lime is known as:Lime Pickling Lime Hydrated Lime Cal Ca(OH)2 Calcium Hydroxide Kalkwasser. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Until recently using caustic and toxic Sodium Hydroxide (lye, drain cleaner) was the only option as the base when extracting DMT. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Lye is very potentially dangerous These Teks instead use Lime. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Lime is a powerful base that is  food safe. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- There have often been difficulties obtaining lime, though it is cheap and available in large quantities. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Here are some tips: Lime is used in gardening, pickling of foods and also aquariums. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- If those stores don t have it then one could  a hardware store though often it is only available in LARGE (like 5kg) quantities and many gardening lime products are not Ca(OH)2 so make sure to look up a MSDS on a product to be sure. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_

- 5ml and or 1ml one or moreTincture bottles (1,2,4 or 8 dram) or very small airtight containers (10-20ml) one or moreSauce cups shot glasses onespoon onelighter candle heat source Preparation: Step 1: Prepare your supplies This Tek can get a little messy, so it s best to have everything prepared ahead of time. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Alternative Next-Steps Now that you have a solvent containing dissolved DMT there are several methods to complete the tek besides my method. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- There are 3 alternative methods to get the DMT out of the solvent, Each is explained in detail in BLAB (Step 4) by all means give them a look and if you prefer them then do them instead. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- My preferred method is below Salting with Vinegar: Cloudy d-limonene floating on top of yellowish vinegar This step uses vinegar (acetic acid) to convert the DMT-freebase in the solvent to DMT-acetate which are water soluble, but not soluble in d-limonene or xylene. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- It is called salting and is  just getting the DMT out of the solvent. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Note 1: Xylene and D-Limonene are very leaky, most containers will eventually start leaking during the salting process. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- I recommend high quality mason jars that you ve tested the lids to make sure the solvent doesn t react with. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Step 1: Pour some vinegar into the sealable container with the solvent. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- The solvent will quickly start to get cloudy and the vinegar will gradually get more yellow. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- You don t have to wait until the solvent gets clear, it doesn t seem to relate to the process being finished. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Step 3: Use a turkey baster pipette to suck out the vinegar (bottom layer) and transfer it to a separate clean container. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Note 2: Try to get as little of the solvent during the separation as possible. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- This solvent will leave plant oils and other junk in your end product. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- That being said, a 1mm layer of solvent atop your vinegar is common using this method. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Step 4: Repeat steps 1-3 once in exactly the same way, combine the separated vinegar pulls in a sealable container. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Step 5: For those more patient lazy, plan for your next non-polar solvent use. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Condensing Tincture Making: The process of condensing vinegar from light yellow liquid to a dense red tincture (all pulls from 500g MHRB) This step is just to concentrate the vinegar containing the DMT down to a dense liquid tincture which can easily measure dosages by number of drops. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Note 1: You could technically evaporate the vinegar completely until it no longer smells of vinegar and you have a very pure smokeable product. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- A far more useful alternative to a vinegar tincture would be making a more traditional tincture using ethanol. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- There are many steps to do in the condensing, so I HIGHLY recommend combining several batches of vinegar saltings into one because it makes your house smell very vinegary for a few hours and it is much more time energy consuming to do many times. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Step 1: Filter the vinegar through a cotton ball placed in the stem of a funnel into a pot. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Then pour about a shotglass of water through the cotton ball into the pot to wash out any remaining vinegar. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Step 2: Boil the vinegar down on max until it is around 40-50ml Step 3: Remove the pot from heat, then use a dropper to carefully filter the liquid through a cotton ball back into the pot then wash the vinegar out of the cotton ball again with water. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- The combined vinegar from 3 solvent pulls will result in roughly 1tsp 5ml for every 100g MHRB used at 10mg drop. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Quantitative Concentration (numerical): - Drop 10 drops of the vinegar tincture onto a flat glass coaster. - Put it on MIN on top of an electric element (95-115C) NOT TOO HOT OR IT WILL SHATTER! - Once the liquid has dissolved and it smells strongly, but not of vinegar, turn off the element and let it sit until cool enough to handle. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- During the cooling, measure the weight of a razor blade using a 0.01g or 0.001g scale. - Remove the coaster from the element then scrape up the goo with a razor and measured using the scale. - Subtract the weight of the razor blade then divide the number by 10 and that is the concentration per drop. - Label the tincture with the concentration. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Qualitative Concentration (subjective): This method is much more advised for smoking and not recommended for pharmahuasca mucosahuasca - Use one of the methods from the next section to evaporate 1 drop of the tincture and test the effects of the product when smoked. - If the effects are not as strong as desired then try 2 drops, then 3, 4, etc. until adequate effects are achieved. - Concentration will then be number drops Mild number drops Strong number drops Breakthrough number drops Too Strong! - Label the tincture with the recommended drops for a dosage. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- DMT acetate is a somewhat unstable acid-salt and decomposes into freebase DMT with heat, so it is readily smokable (and doesn t taste like vinegar) The Slow and Patient Method Simply put a number of drops of tincture for a single dose of DMT on your smoking material and let it dry for a few hours before smoking. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Smoking materials: Neutral Herb (Mullien, Peppermint) Maoi Containing Herb (Caapi, Passionflower) Pre-torched Ceramic Fiber Ball Pre-Charred Copper Kitchen Scrubber Ball Silicon Carbide Ceramic Foam Caution: Vinegar on copper may result in smoking small amounts of copper acetate which is not good for you. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- 1: On Glass - Stove Oven Method - Drop a dose of DMT from the tincture onto a flat glass coaster (I got my from the dollar store and then removed the rubber feet and glue from the bottom) - Put the glass onto an electric stove element or into an oven at AS LOW AS POSSIBLE (do not use a gas stovetop) - After the liquid evaporated and it doesn t smell of vinegar it is ready. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Usually about 1-2 minutes or 5 for fewer drops - You can either: a: Scrape up the liquid with a razor blade and transfer it to any smoking material b: Let the glass cool to the touch then scrape it up with some herb copper mesh Note: hot DMT-acetate goo is very liquidy and hard to scrape up, the closer to room temperature it is, the thicker and easier it will be to scrape up. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- 2: With a Spoon - Lighter Candle Method Note:As much as this method might remind someone of a heroin addict preparing his smack for injection it is just vinegar being evaporated in a quick manner. - Drop a dose of DMT from the tincture onto a spoon then heat it from below with a lighter or candle flame. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Be careful not to heat too quickly or it will spatter and DMT some will be lost. - Continue to heat until the liquid has all gone and you re left with a thin red liquidy goo that smells strongly but not of vinegar. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- A hot spoon will rapidly evaporate excess liquid without a flame below, so you can stop heating slightly before the process is finished. - Carefully scrape up the goo with some herb copper mesh. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- The mush will absorb a portion of the solvent, this is normal. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Stir the solvent around all the bark-mush. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- I recommend pouring it off and doing the vinegar step at 1 day and 2 days, early pulls will yield less. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Combine all the vinegar pulls you have and carefully evaporate them until they start turning red. (you can optionally filter it) Look at the condensing step for a color reference for a good concentration. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- 2: Evaporate all of the vinegar in a flat-bottom glass dish in an oven on the lowest setting then take it out as soon as (or slightly before) all the liquid is gone. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Once the resultant goo smells strongly, but not of vinegar then let it cool. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Prepare a small glass-dropper with a minimal amount of ethanol (1 gram of DMT dissolves in about 3ml of 75 ethanol) Scrape up the goo on a razor then use a toothpick to transfer the goo into the bottle to make your tincture. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Unlike vinegar, the stability of DMT in ethanol is unknown currently (tests ongoing) so use caution with your DMT stores. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Tek 2: The Fluffy White Funfest About Naphtha Naphtha petroleum is a non-polar solvent and the only non-food-safe ingredient, though its toxicity is quite benign. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- The LD50 (amount needed to consume for 50 of subjects to die) for naphtha is stated as 8000-20000mg Kg while the LD50 for DMT is 60-110mg Kg. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- If you are in the US then VM P Naphtha is your choice. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Wait an hour or two for it to evaporate. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- TwoContainers that fit one in another (HDPE plastic, glass, metal, something naphtha won t dissolve degrade) oneElectric Kettle or Stove w pot (kettle is best) one or morebaking pans wide mouth containers for freezer precipitation onefreezer 30g or moreMimosa hostilis root bark (MHRB) 50ml or more5 White Vinegar (CH3COOH) SomeLime Ca(OH)2 100ml or moreNaphtha one or morechopsticks or wooden spoons(to stir the gooey bark) Useful tools a fewPlaying cards one or morerazor blades scrapers Somecoffee filters Preparation: Step 1: Prepare your supplies This Tek can get a little messy, so it s best to have everything prepared ahead of time. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Caution: Naphtha fumes are toxic and it evaporates very quickly, so do all of the following in a ventilated area (window open and or a fan). _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- If you have it in a bowl: Stir the bark-mush around to contact the solvent with a spoon or chopstick. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- When the bark-naphtha mush has been warmed, but is not too hot to handle, seal the container and roll the container around in your hands to mix it. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Regularly open the container to vent the pressure from the warm naphtha. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- You can use any naphtha-safe container though, the crystals sometimes float around in plastic containers, but not always. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- If you have it in a sealable container: Prepare a funnel with a cotton ball in the neck over your precipitation container then use a turkey baster or pipette to suck up the solvent and squirt by squirt put it through the funnel. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Once your solvent is in you precipication container, proceed to the next step. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- If you see some clear liquid (water) under your naphtha, this is not good for the next step. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Precipitation Crystallization: The first pull of naphtha from 500g of MHRB after being in the freezer overnight This step works on the principal that naphtha can dissolve DMT-freebase quite well when warm hot but can barely dissolve any when it is freezing. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- When the naphtha with DMT-freebase dissolved in it is cooled the DMT precipitates out slowly as crystals. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- If the naphtha still looks clear and colorless, don t worry this is normal. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- The naphtha will be either colorless or slightly slightly yellow, especially on the first pull. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Note: You can cover the container with saran-wrap or a lid, but although naphtha smells pretty strong, it doesn t linger too long like d-limonene or xylene. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- If the naphtha is still foggy that means that there are microscopic DMT-freebase molecules trying to find a crystal to attach to. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Step 4: Once you are satisfied with the snow-globe take your precipitation container out of the freezer and very gently pour off the naphtha back into your bark-mush. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Make sure to pour it off slowly so none of the crystals spill out, then find a (preferably outdoors) place to lean your precipitation container against, the few drops of excess naphtha will drip off and all of the naphtha surrounding the crystals will evaporate in a couple of hours. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Sometimes the crystals are floating all over, however usually just SLOWLY pouring the naphtha off works fine. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- You may use a coffee filter to catch them if you prefer. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Once your container no longer smells like naphtha the DMT-freebase is ready! _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Scrape them up with a razor or a small spoon and put in a small sealable container or baggie for storage. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- I am pretty sure it is either DMT-n-oxide or Jungle DMT which are both readily smokable and psychoactive like the white DMT crystals. - You can do a re-crystallization for larger crystals ( - If the first 2 pulls don t cloud or precipitate crystals after 8-12 hours then check something in the extraction did not work correctly. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- This is my prefered method, but I know everyone loves pretty crystals, so this might take some of the magic out of Tek 2 for many people. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- The closer to 6 hours you the more DMT you ll get on your first pull Use a bowl underneath containing hot water to warm your bark mush. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Stir the naphtha around all the bark. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Wipe the bottom of your bowl dry, then gently pour off the naphtha into a container which will go in the freezer (optionally through a coffee filter to catch sediment). _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- If the naphtha is at a low level in the container you may want to wrap it in saran wrap to prevent evaporation. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Slowly over 8-12 hours the DMT will precipitate out of the naphtha and form crystals on the container. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- When the naphtha is no longer cloudy then gently pour the naphtha off the crystals and back into your bark mush (you may use a coffee filter if you prefer). _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Put the container on its side to allow the naphtha to evaporate. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- When the crystals no longer smell of naphtha they are ready to smoke or whatever. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Your first pull will only contain a portion of the total DMT, I recommend warming the naphtha, seperating and crystallizing again at 1 day, 2 days, 1 week and 2-3 weeks. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Each pull will yeild less DMT. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- There are 5 likely causes of no DMT or very small yields of DMT. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Your Lime is not Calcium Hydroxide This will mean that the pH of your basified bark mush is not high enough to convert the DMT-acetate to DMT freebase. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Adding lime and water to the mix may fix this, but it depends on what your previous lime was. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Your Solvent was not the D-limonene Xylene Naphtha that was mentioned in the Teks. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- This will result in either no DMT being dissolved in the solvent, the solvent mixing with the bark, no precipitation of DMT, no salting of DMT or maybe something else. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- If your solvent evaporates on glass without leaving reside, completely dry out your lime-bark-solvent outside until it is crumbly (DO NOT USE HEAT!) and then proceeding to pull with proper solvent. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- If your solvent leaves a residue when evaporated on glass then it has additives in it and you risk significant health problems by doing anything further, just throw everything out and start again with fresh MHRB and proper solvent! _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Your MHRB is not MHRB This  means you have no DMT to extract, so there is no solution to this issue other than getting yourself real MHRB 4: Your MHRB is not powdered I have tried about 5x to get this tek to work with shredded bark and got a maximum of 5 the yield as powdered bark. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- It might be better to just do a lye tek with your MHRB 5. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- Your vinegar is not 5 acetic acid This will result in a successful, but 5x slower tek as it makes it a lime STB. _B_Extraction_Tek.html_
- You will have to wait much longer for the lime to work on the MHRB, but you just need patience and you ll get a full yield Good luck in all your life s endeavors! _B_Extraction_Tek.html_

- Extraction of the Plant Material  the extractor has a fairly wide array of choices for a starting material to extract from (see the DMT is Everywhere chapter of TiHKAL), but the most popular choices are Mimosa and Acacia. _DMT_Extraction_Overview.html_
- Mimosa seems to be ideal, since many people report surprisingly pure product with minimal purification. _DMT_Extraction_Overview.html_
- If you re using any plant material other than Mimosa, it s recommended that you follow this route because it lends itself to more thorough purification of the product. _DMT_Extraction_Overview.html_
- The basic idea is to simply cover the root bark with water basified to pH 13 and pulverize the material, creating an aqueous solution in which the DMT freebase is not very soluble. _DMT_Extraction_Overview.html_
- Xylene and toluene are not recommended for this step, particularly with Mimosa, as they will carry along a red pigment that can end up in your final product (some people extract with these solvents with the explicit intent of extracting the red pigment, which has been reported to be psychoactive itself). _DMT_Extraction_Overview.html_
- On the other hand, Mimosa extractors have found that a much higher pH is necessary; this is likely due to the effects of various phytochemical solutes on the polarity of the aqueous phase. _DMT_Extraction_Overview.html_
- On the other hand, many people find that Mimosa has little enough fat content that defatting leads to an unnecessary loss of product. _DMT_Extraction_Overview.html_

- The pods have a width of 3 to 5 mm (0.12 to 0.20 in) with thick pale-coloured margins. _Acacia_gloeotricha.html_
- The shiny black seeds are arranged longitudinally in the pods and have a broadly elliptic shape with a length of around 4.5 mm (0.18 in) and a white aril. _Acacia_gloeotricha.html_
- Relationships not clear but perhaps has some affinities with Acacia ridleyana ; both species have free sepals and variably united petals, linear, acuminate bracteoles and linear, terete or subterete pods. _Acacia_wilsonii.html_
- However, Acacia ridleyana has pulvinate, flat, much shorter phyllodes with clear articulation between pulvinus and branchlet. _Acacia_wilsonii.html_
- Phyllodes that are epulvinate and continuous on the branchlets are not common in section Plurinerves. _Acacia_wilsonii.html_
- Both Acacia campylophylla and Acacia chapmanii , in this section, have such phyllodes, but they are much shorter than those of Acacia wilsonii and furthermore, their petals and sepals are free and they have very different pods. _Acacia_wilsonii.html_
- Geographic distribution Beard s Provinces: South-West Province. _Acacia_wilsonii.html_
- Seeds longitudinal, oblong, 2 3 mm long, dull brown, tuberculate, the tubercles irregular-shaped; aril apical, yellow. _Acacia_wilsonii.html_
- The pods are straight, cylindrical Often grows in rocky areas, in Eucalyptus woodland or forest or closed heath. _Acacia_aculeatissima.html_
- Acacia aculeatissima may be confused with Acacia brownii which has 5-merous flowers and spreading rather than mostly reflexed phyllodes. _Acacia_aculeatissima.html_
- Plants with either hairy or glabrous phyllodes occur in the Grampians, Vic.; hairy phyllode variants are rare elsewhere. _Acacia_aculeatissima.html_
- Branchlets slender, finely ribbed, variably hairy, rarely glabrous. _Acacia_aculeatissima.html_
- Phyllodes Phyllodes mostly patent to reflexed, slender, terete to subterete, quadrangular when dry, 5 12 (- 20) mm long, 0.5 1 mm wide, pungent with a slender, c. _Acacia_aculeatissima.html_
- 1 mm long cusp, rigid, obscurely 4-nerved, variably muriculate on nerves, usually glabrous; pulvinus asymmetric. _Acacia_aculeatissima.html_
- Extraction Cultivation Acacia aculeatissima grows in full sun to part shaded areas in most well drained soils including coastal. _Acacia_aculeatissima.html_

- Contents 1Introduction 2Description 3Relation between the phytotomy of A. peregrina and its ecology 4Habitat and range 5Phytochemicals with an emphasis on psychoactive compounds 6Human use 7Conclusion 8See also 9Sources Introduction Utilized by indigenous peoples as a medicine and hallucinogen for thousands of years, Anadenanthera peregrina was first described as a species in 1737 in the Hortus Cliffortianus from a specimen in Holland, 2 though the use of the hallucinogenic snuff (usually called yopo or cohoba) produced from the seeds and other parts of this species were documented by Spanish explorers as early as 1496. _Anadenanthera_peregrina.html_

- The Crucial Point - The pH Depression Keep your eye on the PH looking for a pH depression . _Super-Easy_No-Filter_Harmalas_Tek.html_
- While adding the ammonia will raise the pH anywhere from 0,01-0.04 per drop or two and stay completely stable if you stop adding the ammonia. _Super-Easy_No-Filter_Harmalas_Tek.html_
- As soon as the pH depression is reached then the pH will start to lower slowly, sometimes over 0.5 if you wait long enough. _Super-Easy_No-Filter_Harmalas_Tek.html_
- Take careful note of the pH that the depression starts at. _Super-Easy_No-Filter_Harmalas_Tek.html_
- The actual pH number is much less important than the observed pH depression. _Super-Easy_No-Filter_Harmalas_Tek.html_
- If your pH meter is not well calibrated, it technically could still work, just look for the depression even if it is at a different pH than those mentioned. _Super-Easy_No-Filter_Harmalas_Tek.html_
- As you re adding ammonia, the milky color change will take longer and longer to disappear as you get close to the pH depression point. _Super-Easy_No-Filter_Harmalas_Tek.html_
- Once you ve observed a pH depression of at least 0.1, keep adding ammonia and the pH will either stabilize or very slowly rise. _Super-Easy_No-Filter_Harmalas_Tek.html_
- Note: A pH meter with only 0.1 resolution may result in you not necessarily seeing a drop in pH, but suddenly reaching a point where, for example, 7 drops would previously raise the pH by 0.1 but now it takes 20 drops and the solution clouds rapidly. _Super-Easy_No-Filter_Harmalas_Tek.html_
- While 0.05 or 0,01 resolution is better, that observation would likely indicate a pH depression with a 0.1 resolution. _Super-Easy_No-Filter_Harmalas_Tek.html_

- Any member who has been nominated for a position and is unable to attend the Annual General Meeting must notify the secretary of his or her acceptance of said position, in writing or electronically, before the close of nominations. _Constitution.html_
- Common Seal of the Association The Association must have a common seal on which its corporate name appears in legible characters. _Constitution.html_
- The common seal of the Association must not be used without the express authority of the Committee and every use of that common seal must be recorded by the secretary. _Constitution.html_
- The affixing of the common seal of the Association must be witnessed by any two Executive members. _Constitution.html_
- The common seal of the Association must be kept in the custody of the Secretary or of such other person as the Committee may decide. _Constitution.html_
- Declaration of Conflict of Interest A Committee member having any direct or indirect pecuniary interest in a contract, or proposed contract, made by, or in the consideration of, the Committee (except if that pecuniary interest exists only by virtue of the fact that the member of the Committee is a member of a class of persons for whose benefit the Association is established), must: as soon as he or she becomes aware of that interest, disclose the nature and extent of his or her interest to the Committee; and not take part in any deliberations of decision of the Committee with respect to that contract. _Constitution.html_
- Secretary In addition to any other provisions set out elsewhere in this Constitution, or any regulation or policy made thereunder, it shall be the duty of the Secretary: to maintain an up to date register of the members of the Association and their contact information; to carry out administrative work of the Association for which the Committee does not appoint or elect an officer; to record the proceedings of all General Meetings and meetings of the Committee and make these minutes available to members upon request; to conduct and keep copies of all correspondence to the Association; to ensure that an accurate copy of the Association constitution is maintained in an easily accessible online resource; unless the members resolve otherwise at a general meeting, have custody of all books, documents, records and registers of the Association, other than those required to be kept and maintained by, or in the custody of, the Treasurer. _Constitution.html_
- The Annual General Meeting must be held in every calendar year within 4 months after the end of the Association s fiscal year or such longer period as may in a particular case be allowed by the relevant regulatory bodies, except for the first Annual General Meeting which may be held at any time within 18 months after incorporation. _Constitution.html_
- This meeting must be notified by the Secretary as with all other General Meetings, or if the Secretary has resigned or is unavailable by any member of the Committee with the same notice requirements of the Secretary. _Constitution.html_
- Notice of Motion Ammendments to this Constitution or any other motions beyond the usual powers of the Committee must be included in the Agenda of the General Meeting. _Constitution.html_
- Cancellation of Membership The Association may cancel the membership of any member of the Association, should that member have acted in a manner contrary to the best interests of the Association. _Constitution.html_
- Such written consent must be tabled and minuted at the next meeting of the Committee. _Constitution.html_
- Within one month of the passing of a special resolution altering its Constitution, or such further time as the relevant regulatory body may in a particular case allow (on written application by the Association), the Association must lodge with the relevant regulatory body notice of the special resolution setting out particulars of the alteration together with a certificate given by a member of the Committee certifying that the resolution was duly passed as a special resolution and that the Constitution of the Association as so altered conforms to the requirements of the relevant regulations. _Constitution.html_
- Dissolution If upon the winding up or dissolution of the Association there remains after satisfaction of all its debts and liabilities any property whatsoever, the same must not be paid to or distributed among the members, or former members. _Constitution.html_
- The surplus property must be given or transferred to another incorporated association which has similar objects and which is not carried out for the purposes of profit or gain to its individual members, and which association shall be determined by resolution of the members. _Constitution.html_

- As mentioned before Methoxetamine was developed with rational design involved, it is a Ketamine analogue and has it s N-ethyl group chosen specifically to increase the over-all potency by weight of the compound. _MXE.html_
- By altering this compound it can be dosed in smaller amounts, greatly reducing the possible risk of interstitial cystitis that may be possible from norketamine build-up in heavy Ketamine users for example. _MXE.html_
- This compound was also originally designed for daily use in treatment of the creators Phantom Limb Syndrome Neurological Pain Emotional Depression, this does not in any way make it safe to dose daily. _MXE.html_
- Dissociatives have a bad reputation but contrary they are not nearly as toxic as many make them out to be, this said I recommend anyone to dose only once every 2-3 weeks and even then infrequently; we are still dealing with unresearched chemicals here. _MXE.html_
- Your heart rate might also be raised from the DRI effect, take care to not mix with any other stimulants or heavy vasodilators, and especially MAOis. _MXE.html_

- Always know your dose, and compound; set and setting. _MXE.html_
- Dosages and consumption methods Samples of MXE -Methoxetamine can be taken in various routes of administration, each one slightly changing the effects, duration, and dose required. _MXE.html_
- The compound may be taken Nasally, Orally, Rectally, IM, and IV. _MXE.html_
- I do not condone the latter two because of various safety and procedure reasons. _MXE.html_
- Because of this I will only list subjective doses for the former three routes; keep in mind everyone doses differently and these doses will not apply for everyone. -Nasally Duration - 3-4 hours, 2-3 hours of after effects. _MXE.html_
- History of usage This compound has a very small amount of history in regards to human use, many users have reported the compound to be quite pleasurable and addicting; this leads some users to use the compound daily for months. _MXE.html_
- No real health problems have been reported YET but long-term users report feeling their dopamine depleted on stopping; a crash were one feels sleepy, depressed, bored, and tired for a few days after use. _MXE.html_
- This can be easily avoided by spacing your use out over a span of months instead of days. _MXE.html_
- Taking frequently long breaks from dissociatives helps reduce the urge to re-dose as well as allows your receptors time to adjust and your tolerance to become normal. _MXE.html_
- Remember to keep yourself hydrated as well throughout the experience, taking all these precautions will help insure this drug will have a positive long-term history of use. _MXE.html_

(Both along with reportedly a handful of other chemicals are also known as Benzo Fury ) Elaborate studies on this substance have not been performed, so long term effects are UNKNOWN 6-apb is thought to potentially be cardiotoxic due to it s agonism for 5-HT2B - thought to be similar to MDMA MDA in neurotoxicity - recommended not to partake more than 1-2 times per month is the general consensus! _6-apdb.html_
- In animal studies, 6-APDB fully substitutes for MBDB and MMAI but not for amphetamine or LSD. _6-apdb.html_
- 1 These values are very similar to those of MDA, but with those for the catecholamines slightly lower in comparison, perhaps more similarly to MDMA. _6-apdb.html_
- 1 Though 6-APDB does not substitute for amphetamine in rats at the doses used in referenced study, based on its in vitro profile it can be suggested that it may have amphetamine-like effects at higher doses. _6-apdb.html_
- The unsaturated benzofuran derivative 6-APB, or 6-(2-aminopropyl)benzofuran is also known, 2 but the difference in pharmacological effects between 6-APB and 6-APDB is unclear. _6-apdb.html_
- Anecdotally however, 6-apdb is suggested as being more visual and slightly more potent than that of the effects of 6-apb. _6-apdb.html_
- 6-apdb is an analogue of MDA where the heterocyclic 4-position oxygen from the 3,4-methylenedioxy ring has been replaced with a methylene bridge. and similar in structure and effects it is an stimulant entactogenic compound of the phenethylamine and amphetamine classes. _6-apdb.html_
- Contents 1Effects 1.1Desired 1.2Neutral 1.3Undesired 2Toxicity and harm potential 3Links 4Reference Effects 6-apdb effects usually last between 6 12 hours(apparently the duration is highly dose dependent). _6-apdb.html_

- Stage 3 happens about another 2-3 hours later so total time elapsed from initial dose approx. _6-apdb.html_
- Unfortunately I am unsure of how long this would have continued at stage 3 although other reports indicate as mentioned above trips lasting up to 12 hours, I am unsure of this information, the subject was unable to continue testing at this time and had wished to bring himself down with some etizolam so he could be well rested for work the next day. _6-apdb.html_

- We depend on the contributions of all Nexians, be it seniors or new members, to create, maintain and update the quality information here. _Attitude_Page.html_
- If you have enjoyed, learned from and made use of the information and discussions here, please take your time to also contribute back. _Attitude_Page.html_
- Each person has their own unique way to contribute, so you have to find your own. _Attitude_Page.html_
- Give back, and be a co-creator of this incredible place :) Respectful communication Watch your language. _Attitude_Page.html_
- Communication is comprised of not only the explicit but also the implicit messages, which are transmitted through choice of words and general tone of speech. _Attitude_Page.html_
- We do not want curse words and immature slang in the Nexus! _Attitude_Page.html_
- Please use language in a dignified manner. _Attitude_Page.html_
- Safe and constructive drug talk This forum is not a place for superficial unsafe talk of drugs such as excessive use and dosages, unsafe combinations and settings and careless use of substances that naturally have a riskier profile without due  and clear signs of having learned from mistakes and offering insights for better usage. _Attitude_Page.html_
- See this thread for more info: Policy regarding discussion of different drugs. _Attitude_Page.html_
- Also we do NOT give medical advice here (such as telling people not to see doctors and go to shamans for serious medical problems, etc), as this thread explains. _Attitude_Page.html_
- Lastly, please read the Health and Safety section and the for contraindications, facts and tips on safety, reducing risks, dealing with difficult experiences, integrating the trips and maximizing benefits. _Attitude_Page.html_
- Critical thinking and basic autonomy We try to encourage and expect critical thinking between members. _Attitude_Page.html_
- We do not want people displaying arguments and trains of thought that are reckless and dangerous, or talking about things that can be a liability. _Attitude_Page.html_
- Quality of information and discussion If you post something as a fact, you have to be able to provide a reliable source for your argument. _Attitude_Page.html_
- This depends contextually, but a peer-reviewed publication is an example of what could be a good source, and a random unknown website or what someone said could be an example of an unreliable source. _Attitude_Page.html_
- If you state something as your opinion then please support that opinion with good reasoning. _Attitude_Page.html_
- If you cannot do that then don t state your opinion at all since it s useless for others. _Attitude_Page.html_
- This is not Facebook with like dislike. _Attitude_Page.html_
- It is the chronological moment when minors cease to legally be considered children and assume control over their persons, actions, and decisions, thereby terminating the legal control and legal responsibilities of their parents or guardian over and for them. _Attitude_Page.html_
- This means that at the age of 18 you are considered to have your own freedom and responsibility. _Attitude_Page.html_
- See Street Value of DMT (AND WHY YOU SHOULDN T EVER SELL DMT AND OTHER PSYCHEDELICS) for good reasons why we don t allow this. _Attitude_Page.html_
- This rule is to prevent the use of the DMT-Nexus for the pushing of other peoples agendas. _Attitude_Page.html_
- Often we do not want any association with such groups since any fallout on that group will affect the DMT-Nexus as well. _Attitude_Page.html_
- No preaching If you have an opinion about something, respectfully state it, but please do not talk in absolutes about right and wrong or disrespectfully disregard other world views. _Attitude_Page.html_
- No Conspiracy Theories Due to the divisive nonconstructive fear-mongering nature of CT topics and the fact that they often rely on unreliable anecdotes and sources make them an undesired topic here in the Nexus. _Attitude_Page.html_
- No confrontational attitude Diversity, constructive criticism and differing opinions are welcome. _Attitude_Page.html_
- Nobody has to unquestioningly agree with everything in this community. _Attitude_Page.html_
- Nevertheless, we do not want a confrontational attitude, members that are constantly antagonistic, that turn arguments into fights and worsen the atmosphere. _Attitude_Page.html_
- We don t appreciate dramas or excessive sarcastic posting. _Attitude_Page.html_
- If one is not happy with a discussion, respectfully state why or don t post at all. _Attitude_Page.html_
- Don t use the Nexus for venting your personal frustrations, please question yourself why is each post being written, if it is beneficial to the community. _Attitude_Page.html_
- Please tell any moderators if you have a legitimate complaint or suggestion about the forums, but be patient and don t fuel drama. _Attitude_Page.html_
- We are constantly trying to improve this community and need your help and patience for it. _Attitude_Page.html_
- No sharing of any real life information Due to the nature of the topics discussed on this forum it is not allowed to post any information that will reveal one s identity. _Attitude_Page.html_
- Examples of this are facebook pages, personal websites, email addresses, home addresses, photo s of one self or any other means that will give handles to have you tracked in real life. _Attitude_Page.html_
- No unsafe extraction settings and procedures We are against people extracting or using substances in student dorms parents shared houses or any other unsafe place or where the owners or roommates do not agree with what is being done. _Attitude_Page.html_
- We do not give tips on stealth teks. _Attitude_Page.html_
- Do not do it unless the owner of the place accepts his her full responsibility for the actions being done. _Attitude_Page.html_
- If you don t have such a place to extract now, be patient, many have waited years and years for the right moment. _Attitude_Page.html_
- No discussion about taking entheogens in an unsafe or irresponsible setting Taking entheogens in a place where it is clearly not safe, either physically and or legally, is not supported by the DMT-Nexus. _Attitude_Page.html_
- For this we do not condone discussion of taking entheogens in (semi) public places or where the location is outright dangerous for the person taking the entheogen like on the ledge of a cliff or the top of a building. _Attitude_Page.html_
- No commercial-scaled extractions and reckless spreading The Nexus is not a place for commercial operations and we do not want to support drug dealers; we believe in using these substances for personal use. _Attitude_Page.html_
- If and when sharing these substances, we believe that it has to be done without money or other payments involved, with a careful approach and care when facilitating the introduction and or experience of others. _Attitude_Page.html_
- This cannot be done if the substances are spread on a large scale. _Attitude_Page.html_
- We do not want to turn on the world , those who are ready will seek it. _Attitude_Page.html_
- Indiscriminate spreading of psychedelics can lead to potential serious damage to people and is a big legal liability. _Attitude_Page.html_
- Big extractions (and the preparations leading to it and gathering of materials) can attract the attention of the Law. _Attitude_Page.html_
- Spreading of the message of psychedelics itself through superficial YouTube videos showing use or extractions can also cause a lot of damage to the community (as happened with salvia) and is frowned upon. _Attitude_Page.html_
- Discussions about Novel Psychoactive Substances (RC) and Nootropics are only allowed for full members New members cannot discuss Novel Psychoactive Substances (RC) and Nootropics, only full members can. _Attitude_Page.html_
- Read more about it here NEW SUBFORA Nootropics and Novel Psychoactive Substances (RC) No synthesis talk that uses dangerous watched chemicals and procedures Discussion of simple safe non-commercial synthesis not requiring watched chemicals are tolerated (example: the reduction of DMT N-oxide to DMT with zinc, or the supposed LSA-to-LSH conversion). _Attitude_Page.html_
- Members who have been given the chemical expert status, indicated by the flask icon, are allowed to discuss these topics at their own discretion for harm reduction purposes. _Attitude_Page.html_
- Also a reminder to these flask holders: be aware of your knowledge. _Attitude_Page.html_
- No using the Nexus as a personal meet-up point Due to potential legal risks, we do not want people giving their emails or personal contacts (or displaying full face pictures) openly. _Attitude_Page.html_
- We don t want people telling other members they don t already know to meet up privately, this can be a problem for both the people meeting as well as bringing attention for the whole community. _Attitude_Page.html_
- The only exception we make is that we allow establishing general meeting points for festivals and conferences because you don t have to say who you are in the Nexus when going there, and you can go to the meeting point if you want while remaining anonymous. _Attitude_Page.html_
- If you do meet up, do not bring drugs and be sure to maintain your personal safety. _Attitude_Page.html_

- Effects The effects of muscimol are substantially different from psilocybin and psilocin, as the chemicals target separate parts of the brain. _Muscimol_and_ibotenic_acid.html_
- Muscimol has been shown to lack structured hallucinations in most cases, and the effects are frequently compared to a lucid dream state. _Muscimol_and_ibotenic_acid.html_
- The hallucinogenic effect produced by muscimol is most closely comparable to the hallucinogenic side effects produced by some other GABAergic drugs such as zolpidem. _Muscimol_and_ibotenic_acid.html_
- Peak intoxication is reached approximately 2-3 hours after oral ingestion, consisting of one or all of the following; visual distortions hallucinations, loss of equilibrium, minor muscle twitching (commonly mislabeled as convulsions), and altered sensory perception. _Muscimol_and_ibotenic_acid.html_
- These effects generally last for 6-8 hours, varying with dose. _Muscimol_and_ibotenic_acid.html_
- GABAA receptors are widely distributed in the brain, and so when muscimol is administered, it alters neuronal activity in multiple regions including the cerebral cortex, hippocampus, and cerebellum. _Muscimol_and_ibotenic_acid.html_
- In patients with Huntington s disease and chronic schizophrenia, oral doses of muscimol have been found to cause a rise of both prolactin and growth hormone. _Muscimol_and_ibotenic_acid.html_
- During a test involving rabbits connected to an EEG, muscimol showed a distinctly synchronized EEG tracing. _Muscimol_and_ibotenic_acid.html_
- This is substantially different from indolic psychedelics, as brainwave patterns will generally show a desynchronization. _Muscimol_and_ibotenic_acid.html_
- In A. muscaria, the layer just below the skin of the cap contains the highest amount of muscimol, and is therefore the most psychoactive portion. _Muscimol_and_ibotenic_acid.html_
- A correct dose may be difficult to determine because potency varies dramatically from one mushroom to the next. _Muscimol_and_ibotenic_acid.html_
- Powder dried mushroom in blender food processor to maximize surface area. _Muscimol_and_ibotenic_acid.html_
- Bring water to just below boiling(Around 2 Cups per 15g). _Muscimol_and_ibotenic_acid.html_
- If you have a thermometer you want to keep the temperature between 180-190 F. _Muscimol_and_ibotenic_acid.html_
- Allow mixture to heat for one half to one hour, stirring occasionally. _Muscimol_and_ibotenic_acid.html_
- Do not allow the temperature to go above 200 F or you will begin to destroy the Muscimol. _Muscimol_and_ibotenic_acid.html_
- Strain away the solid mushroom matter(Cheese cloth works well for this) 5. _Muscimol_and_ibotenic_acid.html_
- Pour off the resultant liquid through a strainer into a larger pot. _Easy_Caapi_Vine_Alkaloid_Extraction_Guide.html_
- Boil the resultant brew (about one liter) and reduce to a volume of about 400ml. _Easy_Caapi_Vine_Alkaloid_Extraction_Guide.html_
- Basification of the Brew Dissolve 5g of NaOH in 50ml of water. _Easy_Caapi_Vine_Alkaloid_Extraction_Guide.html_
- Remove Soluble Impurities Siphon off the clear dark-brown liquid and discard. _Easy_Caapi_Vine_Alkaloid_Extraction_Guide.html_
- Rather than wait 12 hours for everything to settle, siphon off the liquid and save it. _Easy_Caapi_Vine_Alkaloid_Extraction_Guide.html_
- Dilute with about 150ml water. _Easy_Caapi_Vine_Alkaloid_Extraction_Guide.html_
- Allow solution to settle. _Easy_Caapi_Vine_Alkaloid_Extraction_Guide.html_
- When the resultant yellow liquid is nearly crystal clear, remove and save it. _Easy_Caapi_Vine_Alkaloid_Extraction_Guide.html_
- Discard the brown sediment. _Easy_Caapi_Vine_Alkaloid_Extraction_Guide.html_
- This sediment is mostly bits of plant material. _Easy_Caapi_Vine_Alkaloid_Extraction_Guide.html_
- Remove Excess NaOH, Salts, Etc. _Easy_Caapi_Vine_Alkaloid_Extraction_Guide.html_
- Reserve this liquid for an overnight settling. _Easy_Caapi_Vine_Alkaloid_Extraction_Guide.html_
- Remove and reserve liquid. _Easy_Caapi_Vine_Alkaloid_Extraction_Guide.html_
- Repeat this step one more time. _Easy_Caapi_Vine_Alkaloid_Extraction_Guide.html_
- Allow to dry under a fan is best. _Easy_Caapi_Vine_Alkaloid_Extraction_Guide.html_
- The second extraction of the reserved liquids yielded another 0.258g. _Easy_Caapi_Vine_Alkaloid_Extraction_Guide.html_
- This is done through reducing or blocking signals to the conscious mind from other parts of the brain. _Dissociative.html_
- Although many kinds of drugs are capable of such action, dissociatives are unique in that they do so in such a way that they produce hallucinogenic effects, which may include sensory deprivation, dissociation, hallucinations, and dream-like states or trances. _Dissociative.html_
- Some, which are nonselective in action and affect the dopamine and or opioid systems, may be capable of inducing euphoria. _Dissociative.html_
- Many dissociatives have general depressant effects and can produce sedation, respiratory depression citation needed , analgesia, anesthesia, and ataxia, as well as cognitive and memory impairment and amnesia. _Dissociative.html_
- See images D E Dissociatives can also be classified by molecular structure. _Dissociative.html_
- The most well known dissociatives used recreationally and in medicine are known as arylcyclohexylamines Another well known dissociative Dextromethorphan (DXM) has a very opioid like structure. _Dissociative.html_
- They carry serious longterm mental and physical risks with their usage. _Dissociative.html_
- Evidence points towards dynorphin, the endogenous κ-opioid agonist, to play a major role in substance addiction. _Dissociative.html_

- Chemical and physical properties Hordenine properties Biochemistry and pharmacology Radiolabeling showed that tyrosine was the biosynthetic precursor to both HMePEA and hordenine in barley (Leete and Marion, 1953). _Hordenine.html_
- Action on isolated frog heart was studied (Ellis, 1949). _Hordenine.html_
- LD50 for mice determined (Aliev et, 1967). _Hordenine.html_
- Effects on the Heobania vermiculata nerve cell firing studied (Avoli et al., 1978). _Hordenine.html_
- Tyramine (HPEA) and N-methyltyramine (HMePEA) were equally effective as pressors and bronchodilators (at 1 ug kg). _Hordenine.html_
- Hordenine has sympathacolytic actions; large doses decreases or inverts the hypertenstve actwn of adrenaline (Raymond Hamet, 1936). .Enzymatic oxidative deamination and behavioral effects on the cat were observed (Clark et al., 1964); hordenine was also studied in relationship to the compulsive gnaw syndrome in the rat Ernst, 1965b). _Hordenine.html_
- Hordenine was studied in laboratory animals, along with 32 other ring-substituted phenethylamines, as protective agents against ionizing radiation (ll yuchenok et al., 1976). _Hordenine.html_
- The occasional observation of hordenine in the urine of racehorses led to a pharmacological study of hordenine administration for performance enhancement (Frank et al., 1990; Hapke and Strathman, 1995). _Hordenine.html_
- Human psychoactivity of hordenine is unknown. _Hordenine.html_
- Natural sources of hordenine Hordeum spp Un-sprouted barley contains no hordenine, but it appears following germination. _Hordenine.html_
- During the four days immediately after germination, the hordenine content was highest, and decreased as the embryo grew older, so that after 25 days no hordenine was present (Torquati 1911). _Hordenine.html_
- Both hordenine and gramine are biosynthesized in barley malt during germination (Mangino and Scanlan, 1984). _Hordenine.html_
- Hordenine was reported in A. berlandieri (Clement et aL, 1997) A rigidula (Clement et aL, 1998), and in fresh trunk bark from A spirorlis (Poupat and Sevenet 1975). _Hordenine.html_
- Hordenine in Aconitum tanguticum (Wang et al., 2002), Algae Hordenine hns been also observed in the marine algae Phyllophora nervosa (Guvcn et al., 1969, 1970), Ahnfeltia paradoxa (Kawauchi and Sasaki, 1978), and the marine red alga Gigartina stellata (Barwell and Blunden, 1981). _Hordenine.html_
- Alhagi spp. hordenine found in the stem (and to a lesser extent, the root) of Alhagi pseudalhagi (Ghosal and Srivastava, 1973b) Ariocarpus spp. _Hordenine.html_
- Ariocarpus kotschoubeyanus (Neal et al., 197la), A fissuratus, vars. fissuratus and lloydii (McLaughlin, 1969) A retusus (Braga and McLaughlin, 1969), A trigonus (Speir et aL 1970) Cannabis spp. _Hordenine.html_
- Traces of Hordenine was identified in the dried leaves of Cannabis sativa (El-Feraly and Turner 1975). _Hordenine.html_
- Desmodium Hordenine has been found in the legumes Desmodium gangeticum (Ghosal and Bhattacharaya, 1972), D. tiliaefolium (Ghosal and Srivastava, 1973a), in Desmodium triflorum (Ghosal et al., 1973) and D. floribundu G. _Hordenine.html_
- Echinocereus merkeri, hordenine also found to be present (Agurell et al 1969). _Hordenine.html_
- Ephedra aphylla (Abdel-Kader et al., 2003). _Hordenine.html_
- Haloxylon salicomicum (El-Shazly et al., 2005). _Hordenine.html_
- It has also been found in L. williamsii by others (Lundstrom and Agurell, 1968a). _Hordenine.html_
- Hordenine, tyramine, and HMePEA were isolated from Lophophora williamsii (McLaughlin and Paul, 1966). _Hordenine.html_
- Hordenine has been isolated from Pancratium maritimum (Sandberg et al. _Hordenine.html_
- 1963) Panicum spp The accumulation of hordenine in the seedlings of Panicum miliaceum continues for at least eight days (Demaree and Tyler, 1956). _Hordenine.html_
- Quantitative analyses were made of P. arundinacea (Duynisveld et al., 1990; Kalen et al., 1992). _Hordenine.html_
- Hordenine and 5-MeO-NMT (5-methoxy-N-methyltryptamine) were also isolated from P. arundinaceae (Wilkinson, 1958; Bourke et al., 1988). _Hordenine.html_
- 2005; Bourke et al., 2008). _Hordenine.html_
- Sageretia from shrubs of the Rhamnaceae: Sageretia hamosa, S. he11ryi, S. melliana, and S. thea (Zhong et al., 1994), Securinega spp. _Hordenine.html_
- Hordenine isolated from the roots of Securinega virosa (Iketubosin and Mathieson, 1963). . _Hordenine.html_
- Hordenine ;vas isolated from Selenicereus grandiflorus and S. pterantltus (Petershofer-Halbmayer et al., 1982), Other cactus Hordenine present in Gymnocalycium saglione (Nieto et aL, 1982), Gymnocalycium spp. (Starha, 1996), Gymnocalycium schickendantzii and Cereus aethiops (Ruiz et aL, 1973) Mammillaria microcarpa (Howe et aL, 1977a) Obregonia deneg1 ii (Neal et al 1971b), Islaya minor Backbg. (Doetsch et aL, 1980) Ariocarpus agavoides and Pelecyphora aselliformis (Bruhn and Bruhn, 1973; Neal et aL 1972), Coryphantha rarnillosa (Sato et aL, 1973), C macromeris var. runyonii (Keller et aL, 1973) and C (Neobesseya) missouriensis (Pummangura et aL, 1981), seven species of Coryphanta. (Homemann et aL, 1972). _Hordenine.html_
- Hordenine, along with tyramine, 3-methoxytyramine, and N-methyltyramine were found in Opuntia species (Meyer et aL, 1980). _Hordenine.html_
- Hordenine was isolated from Stapelia gigantea (Keller, 1981) hordenine, its glucoside and its acetate ester, the quaternary amine candicine, and the flavone luteolin were isolated from the African cactus Stapelia hirsuta L, commonly known as window sill cactus (Shabana et aL, 2006). _Hordenine.html_
- Health risks: Unpleasant physical side-effects including muscle tension, hypertensive crisis, overstimulation, nausea, vomiting, seizures have been reported. _2C-I.html_
- The incidence of unpleasant side effects is less commonly reported than with other closely related substituted phenethylamines. _2C-I.html_
- It was described in Shulgin s 1991 book PiHKAL: A Chemical Love Story. _2C-I.html_
- Effects The onset of effects occurs between one to two hours when taken orally, and 10 20 minutes when insufflated; lasting between 4 to 12 hours (depending on the dose) though some users have reported a duration of 16 18 hours. _2C-I.html_
- A shorter duration is typical for insufflated doses. _2C-I.html_
- Users often report strong physical stimulation. _2C-I.html_
- The effects of 2C-I in moderate to high doses are usually described as of a primarily visual and energetic focus, with little alteration in the mental department. _2C-I.html_
- However, some individuals do report a very strong psychological effect with 2C-I. _2C-I.html_
- History of usage In the early 2000s, 2C-I was sold in Dutch smart shops after the drug 2C-B was banned. _2C-I.html_
- In April 2008, 2C-I was also banned in the Netherlands, along with three other 2C-x phenethylamines previously sold in Dutch smartshops for short periods of time. _2C-I.html_
- During the same period, 2C-I also became available in powder form from several online vendors of research chemicals in the United States, Asia, and Western Europe. _2C-I.html_
- It is often misrepresented as mescaline in US street sale of singular dosages, as it shares some level of similarity in psychological effect. _2C-I.html_
- A major difference between the research chemicals in the 2C-x series and mescaline is a much greater potency by weight and thus also a steeper dose-response in the newer synthetic drugs. _2C-I.html_
- This means that a small carrier material, such as a small candy or pressed pill, is suitable for 2C-I. _2C-I.html_
- That type of small carrier material has an insufficiently small holding capacity to contain a large enough quantity of mescaline to produce a substantial psychoactive effect. _2C-I.html_

- Identification Bark: Characteristically dull brown to whitish grey, smooth when young, more fissured and flaky and more cork-like in older specimens. _Acacia_albida_(Faidherbia_albida).html_
- The slash is fibrous, pink to light brown (Wood 1992: 9). _Acacia_albida_(Faidherbia_albida).html_
- Leaves: Compound and bipinnate with leaflets borne along the pinnae. _Acacia_albida_(Faidherbia_albida).html_

- Leaflets: Grey-blue-green, 4-23 pairs per pinna (varies by region) (Wickens 1969: 182). _Acacia_albida_(Faidherbia_albida).html_
- Flowers: The flowers are borne in dense axillary panicles 3.5-16 cm long, with a peduncle 2-4 cm long. _Acacia_albida_(Faidherbia_albida).html_
- They appear about 2 months after the tree comes into leaf and are sessile or with a pedicel of up to 2 mm. _Acacia_albida_(Faidherbia_albida).html_
- In color they are successively white, cream, and then yellow, and are strongly perfumed (Wood 1992: 10). _Acacia_albida_(Faidherbia_albida).html_
- Flowering commences towards the seventh year (Nongonierma 1976; McGahuey 1985). _Acacia_albida_(Faidherbia_albida).html_

- There is much variation in pod shape both within and between trees (Wood 1992: 10). _Acacia_albida_(Faidherbia_albida).html_

- Extracts of the bark, gum and roots are the main parts used to treat many ailments (Barnes and Fagg 2003: 41-42). _Acacia_albida_(Faidherbia_albida).html_
- Extracts are used as astringents to treat gastrointestinal disorders, particularly diarrhoea (William son 1956; Watt and Breyer-Brandwijk 1962; Kokwaro 1976; Timberlake 1980; Wickens 1980; Muhammed et al. _Acacia_albida_(Faidherbia_albida).html_
- Spicer et al. (2003: 128) state the additional use of the bark in traditional medicine against bleeding, inflammation of the eyes and as an emetic. _Acacia_albida_(Faidherbia_albida).html_
- There is widespread use of the bark to prepare a bronchoemollient for respiratory diseases (Wickens 1980; Anon. _Acacia_albida_(Faidherbia_albida).html_
- Bark and root preparations are also said to have anti-febrile (anti-malarial) properties (Irvine 1961; Wickens 1980; Anon. _Acacia_albida_(Faidherbia_albida).html_
- Other ailments that are treated with preparations from the bark include liver complaints, wounds, ulcers, psychological disorders, kidney diseases, post-partum complications, haemorrage, rheumatism, ear-ache and deafness, colds and gripe (Irvine 1961; Anon. _Acacia_albida_(Faidherbia_albida).html_

- Noopept is a medication promoted and prescribed in Russia and neighbouring countries as a nootropic. _Noopept.html_
- It is taken for it s cognative and memory enhancing effects. _Noopept.html_
- It is reported to improve learning ability and memory (including the initial processing of information, consolidation, and retrieval). _Noopept.html_
- It is also used to prevent the development of amnesia induced by electroshock. _Noopept.html_
- In Russian studies Noopept helped to restore memory and other cognitive functions disturbed as a result of brain injury, local and global ischemia and prenatal damage (alcohol, hypoxia). _Noopept.html_
- The therapeutic effect of the drug in patients with organic disorders of the central nervous system appeared within 5-7 days of treatment. _Noopept.html_
- However, these claims are disputed for their reliability and as of today no western study has verified any of these claims! _Noopept.html_
- Dosing Because of Noopept s potency, a normal dose is small relative to other racetam nootropics. _Noopept.html_
- For cognitive enhancement purposes, a dose ranging from 10-20mg up to three times a day is regarded normal . _Noopept.html_

- For such a dose, the onset of effects takes approximately twenty to ninety minutes and perception may be somewhat altered for up to a day after ingestion. _2C-E.html_

- Larger doses can also cause feelings of extreme fatigue despite being well rested. _2C-E.html_

- Again, many of the more unusual distortions of sound are only experienced after the ingestion (or, rarely, insufflation) of a higher dose. _2C-E.html_

- However, many report that O-Acetylpsilocin s effects differ greatly from that of psilocybin and psilocin. _4-Acetoxy-DMT.html_
- 4-Acetoxy-DMT is currently unregulated and unscheduled as an RC. _4-Acetoxy-DMT.html_
- However, it is subject to analog. _4-Acetoxy-DMT.html_
- O-Acetylpsilocin is unscheduled in the United States. _4-Acetoxy-DMT.html_
- It may be considered an analog of psilocin, which is a Schedule I drug under the Controlled Substances Act of the USA, and as such sale for human consumption or possession to ingest or use for illicit non-medical or industrial intents and purposes could be prosecuted as crimes under the Federal Analog Act. _4-Acetoxy-DMT.html_
- O-Acetylpsilocin could also be considered illegal in the UK under the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971. _4-Acetoxy-DMT.html_
- Ester derivatives of prohibited substances also hold criminal penalties. _4-Acetoxy-DMT.html_
- O-Acetylpsilocin is an ester of psilocin, to which it metabolizes. _4-Acetoxy-DMT.html_
- Be sure to completely analyze and always suspect RC s! _4-Acetoxy-DMT.html_
- Know what the compounds are. _4-Acetoxy-DMT.html_
- A 0.001 scale is needed. _4-Acetoxy-DMT.html_
- Wear proper chem equipment such as clothing, gloves, eye protection and mouth mask. _4-Acetoxy-DMT.html_
- Any small amount can appear on skin, mouth, eyes, nostrils from just waves of the hand; and due to potency can be extremely dangerous if not properly prepared and used. _4-Acetoxy-DMT.html_
- This compound is of rational drug design. _4-Acetoxy-DMT.html_

- Geographic distribution Only known from the high altitude granite slopes of Mount Buffalo National Park, Victoria, Australia, where it occurs above 350 meters in woodlands and heathlands often amongst granite boulders. _Acacia_phlebophylla.html_
- Solitary or twinned spikes, to 6 cm long. _Acacia_phlebophylla.html_
- However due to conservation issues this species is not considered a viable source of tryptamines, as outlined below. _Acacia_phlebophylla.html_
- This is presumed to be due to the young age of the plants versus the old growth that stood before the fire. _Acacia_phlebophylla.html_
- Extraction DONT extract from live plant, plant under threat. _Acacia_phlebophylla.html_
- It has been transplanted to other alpine regions, similar climates and entirely different habitats - all without success. _Acacia_phlebophylla.html_
- Growth is vigorous in the first 2 years, then slows in the third year, after which the plant usually dies within a few months. _Acacia_phlebophylla.html_
- The plants on Mt Buffalo are largely affected by galling. _Acacia_phlebophylla.html_
- This appears to be the result of a parasitic insect, apparently itself an endangered species. _Acacia_phlebophylla.html_
- As a secondary infection there also appears to be a fungus promoting the galls. _Acacia_phlebophylla.html_
- As Mt Buffalo has suffered under drought for the years 1998 to 2002, most plants have suffered greatly. _Acacia_phlebophylla.html_
- Moving from one plant to another, especially if touching or taking samples may promote the distribution of the disease and may cause more damage. _Acacia_phlebophylla.html_
- Some areas are quite  more affected than others. _Acacia_phlebophylla.html_
- There is significant concern for the viability of this population, particularly with the threat of fungal pathogens and other disturbances. (A particular species of local wasp may be associated with the transmission of this fungal pathogen.) Looking walking amongst them from stand to stand has been strongly advised against, due to the risk of spreading the fungal pathogen which at the moment is their greatest threat. _Acacia_phlebophylla.html_
- Attempts at ex-situ cultivation have been mostly unsuccessful and have usually resulted in plants dying at 3 years. _Acacia_phlebophylla.html_
- Healthy plants exist in private gardens near Gatton, Qld, as well as in Ireland, indicating the plant is not as recalcitrant in cultivation or restricted to its alpine environment as was once thought. _Acacia_phlebophylla.html_

- Too many lumens causes problems. _Cannabis.html_
- How many watts of light to use is quite easy to determine using Cannaversity s Grow Room Light Calculator. _Cannabis.html_
- This will give you the ideal watts per square foot to figure out how much wattage is needed for the dimensions of your room. _Cannabis.html_
- From here the easiest approach is take the total watts allowed for your room and find a reasonable amount of lights for the recommendation. _Cannabis.html_
- A recommendation of 2,050watts might be best suited for two 1000watt lights. _Cannabis.html_
- A recommendation of 1,400 watts max might be best suited with two 600watt lights. _Cannabis.html_
- See Figure 2.1 below. _Cannabis.html_
- Each plant has an optimal range of acceptable lumens for every square foot of canopy space. _Cannabis.html_
- Determining the ideal lumens per square foot (aka Foot-Candles, roughly) for your specific setup can be trickier. _Cannabis.html_
- Look at this post on THCTalk about Ideal Lighting Charts. _Cannabis.html_
- Using their High-Pressure Sodium :: Foot-Candles Distance Table on the very right you can see distance (in inches) your light needs to be to achieve 5,000 - 10,000 lumens sf. _Cannabis.html_
- The table features all sizes of HPS lights from 150-1000watt. _Cannabis.html_
- Now look at the second Chart titled Approximate Penetration Range for Some Common HPS Lamps This chart shows at which height each light projects an ideal 9,000 lumens sf footprint creating a dense exotic budtops. _Cannabis.html_
- It also shows where diffuse light closer to 5,000 lumens sf produces less then impressive nuggets. _Cannabis.html_
- For instance, if using a 600watt HPS light, the grower would want to keep the light 18 inches away from the plants to achieve the maximum light density of 9,000 lumens sf. _Cannabis.html_
- If the grower has parts of the plant 26 inches away from the light this will be the less dense bottom nugs given by the 5,000 lumens sf intensity. _Cannabis.html_
- 5,000 lumens sq.ft. produces mediocre to above-average indoor cannabis. _Cannabis.html_
- 10,000 lumens sq.ft. produces exotic Connoisseur quality high-yielding indoor canopies. _Cannabis.html_
- In actuality, this is all a rough guide as each bulb ballast brand will have variation. _Cannabis.html_
- How well your lights are cooled and your overall ambient room temperature will both have a major impact on your ability to bring lights closer to plants. _Cannabis.html_
- Each strain and each phenotype will also have individual variation in its light intensity tolerance. _Cannabis.html_
- Some modern indoor varieties can take quite a bit more then 10,000 lumens sq.ft whereas some varieties can t take over 8,000-9,000 lumens sq.ft. _Cannabis.html_
- Lighting Summary Find the ideal wattage for your room size using Cannaversity s Grow Room Light Calculator Divide total wattage between 2-4 lights Place lights evenly apart as depicted in Figure 2.1 Keep lights above plant tops at the height that provides 9,000-10,000 lumens sq.ft. as given by THCTalk s Ideal Lighting Charts Adjust height experimentally to dial in individual strains, phenotypes and room conditions Hydroponic Systems Cannaversity has a great pictorial of the Various Hydroponic Types Deep Water Culture (DWC) Here is an example from Cannaversity of a Deep Water Culture (DWC) system with a Screen of Green (SCROG) built in. _Cannabis.html_

- I ve found having a half cone to start with followed by a full one, after the effects plateau, makes the big cone come up much easier faster better as it allows the initial acceleration adrenaline attributed to the first cone to subside before pushing further, creating a more relaxed and accepting atmosphere - for first time users its also good for gauging the strength. _Changa.html_

- Fairly large bongs tend to dilute the smoke but is generally allot easier for inexperienced users. _Changa.html_

- It just keeps pushing further and further, making for some extremely elongated expeditions. _Changa.html_
- It also looks like normal leaf and you could even put it back into the herbs original packaging making it extremely anonymous, compared to having crystal laying around. _Changa.html_

- Vovin Vovin s Experimental Recrystallization Sept 2004 Note - This is a work in progress. _Vovin's_tek.html_

- I am a fanatic about the purity of my final product. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- I think it is essential for health reasons to make sure that you have as pure a final result as you possibly can. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- Over the last few months there has been a buzz that using a recrystallization process you could grow essentially pure crystals of DMT. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- If this process becomes refined I think it will be one of the biggest breakthru s in extraction. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- It is a journal of my current experiments to refine this process. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- Once it has dissolved and the liquid slowly becomes cooler. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- It will not be able to hold all of the DMT. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- Hotter liquids can hold larger quantities of dissolved materials than cold liquids can. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- Now, one property of crystals is that they essentially consist of only one element - in this case DMT. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- So by heating a liquid and adding the DMT and then cooling that liquid allowing the DMT to crystallize you are growing pure DMT crystals. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- Thus eliminating any contaminants which will remain dissolved in the liquid. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- It s a good theory, as you will see theory and practice are a world apart. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- Regardless of how you do this there is very little chance of losing the DMT. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- Too little means that the DMT will not be able to dissolve. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- There is very little out there concerning recrystallization so I have decided that I would start from scratch. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- I took about half a gram and placed it in a small 50 ml flask. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- In retrospect this was too much DMT to do at one time. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- The flask I used was only 50 ml. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- I wanted it to be as small as possible so bigger crystals would form. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- Once I finally got the DMT to dissolve I discovered many of the contaminants had not and they were still at the bottom of the flask. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- Once I began to pour off the liquid I seen a bottom layer of crud in the flask. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- I figure this crud is  particles of dust and contaminates that have made its way into the extraction process most likely during evaporation. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- I was quite happy to see that the dmt looking materials dissolved but the crud stayed stuck to the bottom of the flask. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- Well if all else fails at least I know I can get alot of junk out of my product just re dissolving it. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- Once I scraped the crud out of the flask it appeared very dark. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- It reminded me of the basified liquid from the extraction. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- I could also see tiny particles that were  airborne dust that had made its way in during the evap. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- All in all I think it is wise to perform this redissolving process to get these impurities out before one begins recrystallization. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- Update After a while I decided to test a theory on this crud. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- I didn t want to accelerate the process because I was hoping to see how many crystals I would get from a highly concentrated evap like this. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- I began the process with the same DMT I evapped from experiment 1. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- I took away some of it because I had a really hard time getting the large amount I used last time dissolved. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- Once this was done I placed the entire flask into a pot of hot water. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- I let the flask sit in the water until it had become cool to the touch. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- Once that was accomplished I took the flask out and then let it sit for 1 hour at room temperature. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- Then I placed the flask into the fridge to sit again for a hour. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- Last I placed the flask into the freezer where I let it sit overnight. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- In the morning I took the flask out of the freezer and let it sit for 45 minutes on a table. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- The goal here is now that crystals have begun to form that warming the solution to room temperature would dissolve the small crystals again but it would take much longer for the large crystals to redissolve. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- Much like placing a large cube of ice in water. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- It takes a lot longer for a large cube of ice to melt in water than it does for a small chip of ice to dissolve. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- After the 45 miutes I placed the flask back into the refigerator for 1 hour then into the freezer again. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- I used a cool flow of air which I allowed to blow for 5 minutes before I put the flask back into the freezer for 20 minutes. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- I did this because I did not want the solution to get too warm. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- This would cause the crystals the begin to re-dissolve. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- I then allowed the flask to sit on a table for another hour to warm to room temperature. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- After this it was placed into the refigerator for a hour and then in the freezer for 2 hours. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- They were very easy to remove from the sides of the flask. _Vovin's_tek.html_
- They held a grainy shape well. _Vovin's_tek.html_
